description: This PHP source file defines the SaveLeaveEntitlementController class within the OrangeHRM system, specifically in the leave plugin for handling leave entitlement save operations. It manages the retrieval of leave entitlement data, access control, and preparation of data for rendering the UI component related to leave entitlements.

classes.name: SaveLeaveEntitlementController
classes.description: Controller for saving or editing leave entitlement data, extending the AbstractVueController to manage Vue.js components for the leave entitlement interface, handling pre-render data setup.

methods.name: getLocationService
methods.description: Lazy loader for the LocationService instance, creating it if not already instantiated.

methods.name: getCompanyStructureService
methods.description: Lazy loader for the CompanyStructureService instance, creating it if not already instantiated.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares data and component props before rendering the leave entitlement Vue component, including access control, entitlement data, subunit and location lists, and leave period info.
